_meta.description: Plant Trait Ontology (TO) catalog used by the GeneNetworkAgent resolver to map a free-form trait query to a canonical TO id. Each entry has the canonical id, the customer-curated name, and optional synonyms + definition pulled from the upstream .obo.
_meta.filter: Customer-supplied 573-id allowlist (TO_mapping.tsv); 541 matched in the upstream .obo and inherited its synonyms + definition; 32 were not in the latest upstream release and kept as {id, name} only. The customer-supplied TO_Description wins on name divergences (163 entries) so resolver prompts match the in-house terminology.
